content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definitions
content_blocks.text: ‘CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION’ means all information disclosed by Disclosing Party, whether written, oral, or electronic, that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be understood to be confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Restrictions_on_Use
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall use CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential business relationship between the Parties and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Duration
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of three (3) years from the date of disclosure of CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 15th day of October 2024.
